niche_preference_profile: Prefers interfaces that feel structured, polished, and intentionally organized, with strong hierarchy, clear grouping, and complete visible content. They consistently like screens that show enough information to feel useful and finished, with explicit actions and interpretable controls. They also favor cleaner, more serious, system-like presentation over playful or promotional styling, and often respond well to restrained cards, even spacing, and clear navigation cues. However, their preferences around light vs dark themes and spacious vs compact layouts vary by context.

criteria.description: Prefers clear top-down hierarchy with prominent titles, distinct section labels, and obvious grouping that makes the screen easy to parse.
Prefers continuous, well-structured layouts with full-width rows or clearly segmented sections rather than fragmented, mixed, or piecemeal card compositions.
Prefers interfaces that look complete and populated, with visible items, fully labeled rows, and no blank, placeholder-like, or unfinished areas.
Prefers explicit primary actions, visible controls, and clear progression/navigation cues rather than passive, muted, or ambiguous interaction paths.
Prefers crisp, polished component styling with clear affordances and finished presentation over generic, vague, or unfinished-looking controls and cards.
Prefers a serious, neutral, utilitarian or editorial aesthetic over friendlier, softer, more playful, or more promotional presentation.
Prefers even, regular spacing cadence and orderly visual rhythm that supports flow, avoiding awkward gaps, broken pacing, or bulky chunking.
